title: sail.py draft refuses over a standing validate berth
intention: A ticket's chart is never redrafted without being re-charted: sail.py draft refuses while a validate berth already stands for the ticket, and --rechart drafts and charts in one act, refusing unless the validate berth moved.
why: Measured 2026-11-15 on 8f3d61c0ae47: a redraft rewrote only the plan's chart field, the old validate berth went on claiming the ticket, and the verdict gate (which reads that berth, never the plan) refused twice on a criterion the redraft had removed.
traces_to: Law 4: re-chart-after-redraft was a rule only policy held. Law 7: the stale berth was a silent wrong answer.
how: draft reads the standing validate berth by both spellings (chain_for_ticket(tid)['validate'] and Ticket.berth('validate')); if one stands it writes nothing and names it. --rechart drafts, runs chart, and returns 1 unless every standing spelling moved. A red-first proof drives a scratch tickets store, a scratch berth store passed as berths_root, and a recording bus.

clauses.claim: a validate berth claiming the ticket in the berth store: draft exits 1, names the berth and --rechart, and leaves the plan's bytes unchanged
a validate berth recorded only in the ticket's chart_claim: draft refuses the same way
with no validate berth standing, draft writes every chart stage as before
--rechart over a standing berth drafts, charts every stage, and exits 0 when a new validate berth now claims the ticket
--rechart whose charting leaves the old validate berth standing exits 1 and says it did not move

decisions.text: D1: draft in sail.py reads the standing validate berth by both spellings and refuses without --rechart; --rechart drafts, charts and checks the berth moved.
D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause, over a scratch tickets store, a scratch berth store and a recording bus.
